name: @absolutejs/observability
description: Managed AbsoluteJS observability: correlated errors, Replay, vitals, traces, and user-authorized Support Mode through a credential-safe Elysia relay.
author: Alex Kahn

scripts.build: rm -rf dist && bun build src/index.ts --outdir dist --root ./src --sourcemap --target=browser --external @absolutejs/beacon --external '@absolutejs/beacon/*' --external @absolutejs/diagnostics --external '@absolutejs/diagnostics/*' --external @absolutejs/replay --external '@absolutejs/replay/*' && bun build src/elysia.ts src/manifest.ts --outdir dist --root ./src --sourcemap --target=bun --external @absolutejs/beacon --external @absolutejs/diagnostics --external '@absolutejs/diagnostics/*' --external @absolutejs/errors --external @absolutejs/handoff --external @absolutejs/manifest --external @absolutejs/replay --external @sinclair/typebox --external elysia && tsc --project tsconfig.build.json && absolute-manifest emit
scripts.check:package: bun run typecheck && bun run build && bun run test
scripts.release: bun run format && bun run check:package && bun publish
